full_prompt_en: A square photorealistic architectural rendering shows a long sheltered promenade running beside still blue-green water at dusk. On the left, a pale concrete facade rises in repeated bays, with deep window recesses and a few warm interior lights. Small seated figures and cafe tables line the near edge, giving scale to the high overhang. Above the walkway, an intricate branching canopy spans from the building toward the open water. Its irregular perforations reveal patches of pale sky and cast a delicate broken pattern across the surfaces below. A large leafy tree grows near the center-right, its dark canopy partly filling the view beyond the roof. The promenade narrows toward a distant vanishing point, where more trees and low buildings continue along the opposite bank. Water occupies the right half of the lower scene, calm enough to reflect the muted facade and evening sky in elongated soft bands. A low clean parapet separates the paved walking area from the water, its top catching a faint cool highlight. The far horizon remains hazy, with two dark vertical silhouettes rising in the middle distance. The light is diffuse from the bright open sky on the right, supplemented by small warm interior glows on the left; the covered ground remains in gentle shade. Surfaces are crisp in the foreground and fade atmospherically with distance. The overall composition draws the eye along the sheltered linear path while balancing solid modules against an airy, patterned roof and reflective water.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、近似实景的建筑渲染图里，一条长长的有盖步道在黄昏沿平静蓝绿水面延伸。左侧浅色混凝土立面以重复开间向上升起，窗洞较深，少数室内暖灯亮着。靠近画边坐着小人物，摆着咖啡桌，为高大挑檐提供尺度。步道上方，一片精细分枝状顶棚从建筑伸向开阔水面。不规则穿孔露出浅亮天空，并在下方表面洒出细碎图案。一棵大树生长在中心偏右处，深色树冠部分填入屋顶之外的景致。步道渐窄并通向远处消失点，更多树木和低矮建筑沿对岸延续。水面占下方场景的右半，平静到能以拉长的柔和色带映出压低的立面与傍晚天空。低矮干净的栏墙把铺装步行区与水分开，顶部接住一点清冷亮边。远方地平线保持朦胧，中景升起两道深色竖形。光从右侧明亮的敞开天空漫射而来，左侧少量暖色室内光作补充；顶棚下地面留在柔和阴影中。近景表面清楚，远处随空气渐淡。整体构图引导目光沿有盖的线性道路前行，同时平衡坚实模块、通透花纹顶棚与反光水面。
style_prompt_en: The photorealistic rendering favors pale mineral surfaces, repeated rectilinear modules and a contrasting layer of irregular perforated pattern. Cool blue-green reflections and warm small highlights create a restrained evening palette. Foreground edges are clean and accurately lit, while distant forms soften into atmospheric haze. Broad solid planes hold the structure of the image; branching shadows and finely cut openings prevent them from feeling heavy. Light enters laterally through a bright open zone, leaving sheltered areas softly shaded rather than black. Strong linear recession and reflective horizontal bands make the spatial rhythm expansive, precise and calm.
style_prompt_zh: 这种近实景渲染偏爱浅色矿物质表面、重复的直线模块，以及与之相对的不规则穿孔图案层。冷蓝绿反光与少量暖亮点形成克制的傍晚配色。前景边缘干净，受光准确，远处形体则随空气薄雾柔化。宽阔坚实的平面稳住图像结构，分枝状阴影与细切孔隙又使其不显沉重。光从明亮敞开区域横向进入，让受遮蔽处留在柔影中，而非变黑。强烈线性退远和反光横带，使空间节奏宽广、精确且平静。
theme_en: A covered riverside promenade beneath a perforated canopy
theme_zh: 穿孔顶棚下、临水延伸的有盖步道
name: Herzog & de Meuron
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
